note.text: An idiom has a conventional meaning that may not follow from its individual words. Context helps distinguish figurative use from literal description. Break the ice can mean easing social awkwardness; lend a hand can mean helping. An idiom may fit informal speech without fitting every formal task. Explaining it in plain language is often clearer than substituting another unexplained idiom. Learn the phrase and check its context.

sections.heading: Your goal and connections
sections.text: By the end, you should be able to interpret selected idioms and preserve figurative meaning. Builds on: context clues, collocations and discussion. Leads to: narrative dialogue and word replacement.

sections.heading: Read the original model
sections.text: Original dialogue: Bih says, “I will introduce the new members to break the ice.” Ayuk replies, “I can lend a hand with the chairs.” They check that they are on the same page about the plan, then ask Manka to keep an eye on the time. No frozen water or detached body part is involved.

sections.heading: Apply and check
sections.text: Locate the phrase, identify the activity and paraphrase in ordinary words. Preserve the speaker’s idea or request. Do not impose a figurative interpretation when a different context describes a literal action.

cards.idea: Distinguish the ideas used in this lesson.
example: break the ice: help people begin interacting comfortably.
be on the same page: share an understanding.
lend a hand: help with a task.
keep an eye on: watch or monitor something.

cards.idea: Read the whole example before identifying its function.
example: The host used introductions to break the ice.
Let us check that we are on the same page about the plan.
Could you lend a hand with the chairs?
Please keep an eye on the time during rehearsal.

cards.idea: A correction must preserve the intended meaning and form.
example: The host physically shattered a frozen lake. Correction: The social context means easing initial awkwardness.
Everyone must stare at one physical sheet. Correction: The context concerns shared understanding.
Detach a hand and give it away. Correction: The request is for assistance.
Place an eye on the clock. Correction: The request is for attention to time.
